description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Checks the emailed code and returns an API key (shown once). New address: the new account's first key (`account: "new"`). Address that already has a flayr account: a NEW key on that account, capped at read + write (`account: "existing"`); the owner is emailed and can revoke it, and accounts with SSO or with "Allow agent login" off refuse (403). Reconnect to this MCP server with `Authorization: Bearer <apiKey>`.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/agent-signup/verify.)
name: agent_signup_verify
title: Verify agent sign-up
